gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!

gaps.explanation: pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.
